rawFindings.title: MongooseDocumentArray.toObject no longer accepts options
rawFindings.explanation: The toObject() method on MongooseDocumentArray no longer accepts any options parameter and calls each subdocument's toObject() with no arguments. This removes the ability to pass options (such as 'transform' functions or other schema options) to subdocuments' toObject methods, which can break use cases relying on option-driven transformations.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the options parameter to the toObject method and pass it to each subdocument's toObject call, i.e., change line 127 back to 'MongooseDocumentArray.prototype.toObject = function (options) {', and pass options as 'doc.toObject(options)'.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Invoking toObject({ transform: someTransform }) on a MongooseDocumentArray will no longer apply the transform because the changed code no longer passes the options down to each subdocument's toObject. The returned objects omit transformations applied via options.
